18:1.sourceText: Μετὰ ταῦτα χωρισθεὶς ἐκ τῶν Ἀθηνῶν ἦλθεν εἰς Κόρινθον.
18:1.targetText: After this, Paul left Athens and went to Corinth.

The actual article has no distinct counterpart in this English wording.

18:6.targetText: But when they opposed and insulted him, he shook out his garments and told them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am innocent of it. From now on I will go to the Gentiles.”
